description: Fabric resources (phase 51) first, one panel per resource; then per-plane latency, docs outcomes and, with SUBSTRATE_METRICS_HISTORY_SERIES=extended, cache results, brief profile and recall evidence, memory expiry and the outbox and archive gauges. Generated by scripts/dashboards.ts; edit the generator, not this file.

panels.description: Dragonfly is the cache plane, so this is its read-through hit ratio over every key class. Series `cache.hit_ratio` (ratio, wavg per step, ratio), source `substrate.cache.operations`.
panels.title: Fabric: dragonfly

panels.description: The index volume's runway in days, fitted over its size history. Series `capacity.runway_days` (gauge, avg per step, days), source `capacity.index.runway_days`.
panels.title: Fabric: timescaledb-index

panels.description: The greptime line is the ledger's call availability. Series `plane.availability` (ratio, wavg per step, ratio), source `substrate.plane.duration`. One line per `plane`.
panels.title: Fabric: greptime

panels.description: The ragflow line is RAGFlow's call latency at p95. Series `plane.p95` (histogram, max per step, ms), source `substrate.plane.duration`. One line per `plane`.
panels.title: Fabric: ragflow

panels.description: The lightrag line is LightRAG's call latency at p95. Series `plane.p95` (histogram, max per step, ms), source `substrate.plane.duration`. One line per `plane`.
panels.title: Fabric: lightrag

panels.description: Retain forwards parked for replay. Needs SUBSTRATE_METRICS_HISTORY_SERIES=extended. Series `hindsight.outbox_size` (gauge, max per step, {entry}), source `substrate.hindsight.retain_outbox.size`.
panels.title: Fabric: hindsight

panels.description: The tei line is the embedding service's call latency at p95. Series `plane.p95` (histogram, max per step, ms), source `substrate.plane.duration`. One line per `plane`.
panels.title: Fabric: tei

panels.description: A count of the data planes on a configured proxy (SUBSTRATE_DB_PROXY_ALLOW), set at boot from the endpoint classes. Needs SUBSTRATE_METRICS_HISTORY_SERIES=extended. Series `endpoint.proxy_planes` (gauge, max per step, {plane}), source `substrate.endpoint.proxy_planes`.
panels.title: Fabric: tailscale-proxy

panels.description: Age of the newest corpus manifest change; its objective is SUBSTRATE_DOCS_SLO_FRESHNESS_S. No point until the manifest has a change. Needs SUBSTRATE_METRICS_HISTORY_SERIES=extended. Series `corpus.freshness_seconds` (gauge, max per step, s), source `substrate.corpus.freshness_seconds`.
panels.title: Fabric: corpus

panels.description: Median brief duration per surface. No objective. Series `brief.p50` (histogram, avg per step, ms), source `substrate.brief.duration`. One line per `surface`.
panels.title: Brief latency p50

panels.description: p95 of the time to append one event. No objective. Series `emit.p95` (histogram, max per step, ms), source `substrate.emit.duration`.
panels.title: Emit latency p95

panels.description: Per data plane (greptime, index, cache, hindsight, ragflow, lightrag); a refused call (breaker open) carries no duration and is not in it. Series `plane.p95` (histogram, max per step, ms), source `substrate.plane.duration`. One line per `plane`.
panels.title: Plane call latency p95

panels.description: hit, empty or degraded searches per step. Series `docs.search` (counter, sum per step, {search}), source `substrate.docs.search`. One line per `outcome`.
panels.title: Docs searches by outcome

panels.description: One record per detected planning change: applied when the change reached the ledger, refused when it did not. Series `planning.transition` (counter, sum per step, {transition}), source `PlanningObserver scan path (planning/observer.ts)`. One line per `outcome`.
panels.title: Planning transitions by outcome

panels.description: All key classes summed. `would_serve_stale` is counted only for the brief class under `SUBSTRATE_CACHE_SWR=shadow`, beside the `miss` it is a share of. Series `cache.operations` (counter, sum per step, {operation}), source `substrate.cache.operations`. One line per `result`.
panels.title: Cache operations by result

panels.description: Bytes the compact profile saves (full minus compact), fresh answers in shadow or enforce. Series `brief.profile_bytes_saved` (counter, sum per step, By), source `substrate.brief.profile_bytes_saved`.
panels.title: Brief profile bytes saved

panels.description: included, would_include, cold, stale, disabled, dropped_by_cap. Series `brief.recall` (counter, sum per step, {brief}), source `substrate.brief.recall`. One line per `result`.
panels.title: Brief recall results

panels.description: Snapshot refreshes by result. Series `recall.prefetch` (counter, sum per step, {refresh}), source `substrate.recall.prefetch`. One line per `result`.
panels.title: Recall prefetch results

panels.description: served (tagged) or hidden, by what the read did. Series `memory.expired` (counter, sum per step, {entry}), source `substrate.memory.expired`. One line per `mode`.
panels.title: Expired memory entries met

panels.description: Parked retain forwards at the sample; the worst reading in a step. Series `hindsight.outbox_size` (gauge, max per step, {entry}), source `substrate.hindsight.retain_outbox.size`.
panels.title: Hindsight retain outbox size

panels.description: 0 for an empty outbox; the worst reading in a step. Series `hindsight.outbox_oldest_age_s` (gauge, max per step, s), source `substrate.hindsight.retain_outbox.oldest_age_seconds`.
panels.title: Hindsight retain outbox oldest age

panels.description: Age of the newest complete archive. No point until a first archive exists. Series `index.archive_age_s` (gauge, max per step, s), source `substrate.index.archive.age_seconds`.
panels.title: Index archive age

panels.description: Documents per second of the last ingest request's wall time; 0 when it sent nothing. The objective is SUBSTRATE_DOCS_SLO_INGEST_DOCS_PER_S. Series `corpus.ingest_docs_per_s` (gauge, avg per step, {document}/s), source `substrate.corpus.ingest_docs_per_second`.
panels.title: Corpus ingest throughput

panels.description: As the docs canary last reported it. No point until a first report. The objective is SUBSTRATE_DOCS_SLO_RECALL5. Series `corpus.golden_recall5` (gauge, avg per step, ratio), source `substrate.corpus.golden_recall5`.
panels.title: Golden-set recall at 5

panels.description: Seconds the newest reported corpus sync had behind its source change. The objective is SUBSTRATE_DOCS_SLO_SYNC_LAG_S. Series `corpus.sync_lag_seconds` (gauge, max per step, s), source `substrate.corpus.sync_lag_seconds`.
panels.title: Corpus sync lag
